title: Automatic activation when rental start date is reached
gherkin:
Feature: Rent Activation Rule - Automatic Activation
  Scenario: System automatically activates rent when start date is reached
    Given a rent record is in Approved status
    And the rental start date is set to today
    When the system processes the scheduled activation
    Then the rent status should be updated to Active
    And the activation timestamp should be recorded
rationale: Tests the automatic status transition to Active when rental start date is reached, a core behavioral requirement from PRIMARY evidence E1 and E2.
usedContextItems: System shall update rent status to Active when rental start date is reached (automatic activation)|Rent activation requires prior Approved status as a precondition

Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
